browser.scope: full Chromium suite, including real motion entry/exit/reversal, inert logical close, focus restoration, rapid discarded-draft reopening, reduced motion, explicit model-test abort, palette/model/search/canvas-menu regressions, annotations, resizing and real PNG/PDF downloads

screenshots.inspection: All 150 captures inspected through six desktop/mobile contact sheets; the canvas export was inspected at full resolution. The motion captures show real mid-transition states: panel opening, panel closing at opacity 0.656, toolbar reveal, canvas menu opening at opacity 0.972, mobile panel opening and an instant reduced-motion panel with zero running animations. Closing surfaces clip and fade without moving canvas geometry; 44px actions, focus rings and viewport bounds remained correct.
